# exo_hosted_outbound_spam_filter_policy (Resource)

Manages the HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy object via New-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy / Get-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy / Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy / Remove-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `recommended_policy_type` (String) Maps to the -RecommendedPolicyType parameter.
